subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept these 14 upstream action revisions for workflows that handle App private keys, registry credentials, release publishing, security scanning, and Codex API keys?
rationale: The patch is a pinned supply-chain update across secret-bearing workflows; source compatibility does not establish the repository’s trust decision for the upstream executable revisions.

options.title: Approve after owner review
options.body: Rebase the current head, require its workflow checks to pass, and have the security/workflow owners accept the reviewed action revisions.

options.title: Hold the batch
options.body: Pause this grouped update and split or defer the credentialed/release-sensitive action changes until their upstream revisions are independently accepted.

recommendation.title: Approve after owner review
recommendation.body: Rebase the current head, require its workflow checks to pass, and have the security/workflow owners accept the reviewed action revisions.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly routes several of the changed security-sensitive workflows to this team.
